facts.fact: Walter Jones 认出 Carson，断言她是 James 的女孩（You’re James’s girl），随后自我介绍
Walter Jones 告诉 Carson，Beau 已经把她的卡车拆开，而且从他到之前就一直在修
facts.anchor: Beau’s got your truck torn apart. Been at it since before I got here.

facts.fact: Clover Jones 自我介绍是 Beau 的姐妹，并说昨天给 Carson 送了牛奶、很高兴见到她
facts.anchor: Clover Jones. Beau’s sister. I delivered your milk yesterday and am so excited to meet you!

facts.fact: Walter 提醒 Clover，她认识 Carson 才 thirty seconds（三十秒）
facts.anchor: You’ve known her for thirty seconds.

facts.fact: Clover 告诉 Carson：September 1st 是南瓜季开始，September 2nd June 就开始用感情勒索拉人加入 Harvest Festival 委员会
facts.anchor: September 1st means pumpkin season. September 2nd means she starts emotionally blackmailing people into joining the Harvest Festival committee.

facts.fact: Clover 告诉 Carson 丰收节会议七点（seven）在 town hall 开始
facts.anchor: I was just going to tell you the meeting starts at seven.

facts.fact: Clover 说委员会今晚要讨论把丰收节带回 Marigold Ranch，因为公园今年因 permits 和 last season 的排水问题不达标
facts.anchor: They want to talk about bringing it back to Marigold Ranch.

facts.fact: MEME 发短信告诉 Carson：Mrs. Whitaker 打电话来说今晚有 Harvest meeting，她们应该去
facts.anchor: Mrs. Whitaker called. Harvest meeting tonight. I think we should go.
